Smurf - Rescue in Gargamel's Castle.name: Smurf: Rescue in Gargamel's Castle
Smurf - Rescue in Gargamel's Castle.summary: You control a Smurf who is off on an action-packed rescue mission! Gargamel has captured Smurfette, taken her to his castle and imprisoned her! You'll direct Smurf through all sorts of dangerous situations on his way to save her. Will Smurf rescue Smurfette or will she remain imprisoned?
